description: Approve a run that is awaiting approval (beta feature). The budget is reserved in one debit before any step starts; an insufficient balance returns 402 and no step runs. Optionally pass max_credits to lower the budget, or to raise it up to the run estimate. Approving an already approved run is a no-op that returns the current state. Spends credits up to the reserved budget; unused credits are refunded when the run ends.

max_credits.description: Optional new budget for the run
